cases.heading: SGF
cases.prompt: A stunning aerial photograph captured from a drone, circling around a majestic historic church perched atop a rocky outcropping along the Amalfi Coast. The camera captures the intricate architectural details and tiered pathways and patios that adorn the church, with waves crashing against the rocks below. The view extends to the horizon, showcasing the coastal waters and the rolling hills of the Amalfi Coast in Italy. Distant figures can be seen leisurely walking and enjoying the dramatic ocean views from the patios. The warm glow of the afternoon sun bathes the scene in a magical and romantic light, creating a breathtaking and serene atmosphere. The photo has a high-resolution, detailed quality that highlights every texture and color of the landscape. A wide-angle shot from a dynamic aerial perspective.
cases.interpretation_limit: The prompt requests a circling drone view. Composition stability alone does not establish motion quality or prompt adherence; initial rendered frames are visibly different.

cases.visible_observation: The six-frame samples retain a prominent multi-tower church/coast view at all three times; base samples change coastal building composition.
cases.selection: Prompt19, seed 0 and display times fixed before six-frame extraction.
cases.score_availability: No six-frame per-case scores are released with these images; the former nine-frame source-control record remains archived.

cases.heading: Context Forcing
cases.configuration: Native CF denoising; committing reads the current 3 and immediately preceding 3 latent frames, excluding direct sink and earlier-memory access.
cases.visible_observation: An external large hand is visible in Base at 120 s and multiple rake-like tools at 238 s; the Recent-Context Committing samples retain the small figure inside the sphere without that external hand.
cases.interpretation_limit: The prompt requests the small figure raking sand inside the sphere; no external hand is requested. This readable visual contrast coincides with a negative per-video Quality change, not an overall metric improvement.

Inside, a small Eastern dwarf with weathered skin and a serene expression is raking the sand, meticulously creating intricate patterns with a bamboo rake. His movements are deliberate and meditative, enhancing the peaceful atmosphere of the scene. The background is blurred, revealing only hints of greenery and rocks, adding to the serene setting. The sphere itself is polished, reflecting the surroundings subtly. The camera angle captures the dwarf from a slightly elevated position, emphasizing his focused and contemplative pose.
